text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the announcement stream.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Curren, thanks for the comb. It feels 
super nice... 
but through the screen, it still looks 
kind of poofy... Ugh."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, you look perfectly cute, okay? 
Is everyone else ready to go too? 
Especially you two, Maru-Zeph-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. But just a little... an empty 
draft is blowing into my heart..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Chan is too... just a tiny bit. 
Wondering if we can spark that 
interaction... My heart is pounding."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"You'll be fine. The fans are cheering for 
'us,' after all. ...It's time. Let's head 
over—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Today, we have an announcement about 
Curren and everyone's Valentine's Day 
project!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, we decided to change the 
previously announced 'making a chocolate 
cake' project. 
We're so sorry for changing the plans on 
you."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"But you know what?! We've prepared 
something way, waaay more fun... 
a project that everyone is absolutely 
gonna love♪"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, so many 'excited' comments are 
flowing in~. 
Nature-san and the others are already 
getting super fidgety."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... 'You read my comment!' Of 
course I will! 
Because—oops, that's almost a spoiler!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"'Can't wait'... Pardon us. Before we get 
into the details, please give us a little 
more time. 
You two, if you would."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I am the "Mar" of Mar-Zephyr, 
Aston Machan. And this here is Zephyr-san, 
the "Zephyr".

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Surprise! In fact, Machan and Zephyr have 
a present for everyone. ...Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
From Machan, this mosaic art. 
A present for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Can you see it? Can you see it? If you 
look veeeery closely... 
Yes, it is made entirely out of photos of 
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is Machan taken by all of you. 
It is the Machan that everyone remembered.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just as you remembered. The days where you 
remembered Machan, I remember them too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is proof of that. A present of 
gratitude for your love. 
...Note: I have selected photos that were 
marked as usable by the subject.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: From me... this banner.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The banners you hold up for me at every 
race— 
I always see them.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Those banners become a tailwind, always 
pushing 
my back forward. Bringing happiness to me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, so that I too may breathe 
happiness into all of you— 
I tried making a banner. Please, accept 
it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Did you find the photo you took? 
Fufufu, 
I used every single photo I received. 
Everyone, please look for yours.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy the support on our banners 
reached you"—oh, the pleasure is mine... 
I already feel the warmth of the gentle 
spring breeze. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
On Valentine's Day itself, I want to share 
love with everyone like this too. 
—So, we're holding a Valentine's Fan 
Meeting♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
During the stream, we'll be taking 
requests from everyone. 
We'll be responding to them in real time, 
so please do send them in.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
For those who want to send them 
beforehand, check the description 
box—wait, I'm doing it? 
...The submission form is right here! Send 
lots in, okay! ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait! I found a great comment! 
"'Val-Fan-Meet'? Sounds nice!" they say. 
Let's call it 'Val-Fan-Meet' for short♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is saying they're "looking 
forward to it." 
I am looking forward to it as well. Let us 
talk plenty together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then! 
Let's make it the absolute best 
Valentine's ever, everyone! See you soon~♡

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...The reactions to the "Val-Fan-Meet" 
have mostly been compiled. 
—It's going exceptionally well!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Posts saying they're hyped for it are 
trending across all social media. 
Looks like we'll be able to deliver the 
Valentine's everyone is hoping for.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The chat replay is full of positive 
comments too... Wait, though, 
seeing ourselves on screen like this... 
our usual casual clothes are kinda, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, about that! Since we're doing this, 
how about we get some Valentine's-themed 
outfits ready?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I've actually already booked 
the costume vendor's schedule just in 
case☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just how competent are you at your job, 
girl...?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Yes. How about a sweets motif? 
Since Machan is fluffy, Machan requests 
marshmallows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
How lovely. 
I would like to incorporate imagery of the 
forest as well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on, we're going that lovely and 
sweet? All of us?? 
No, I mean, look at me... Shouldn't I wear 
something a bit more down-to-earth—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san. The Val-Fan-Meet is a project 
to fulfill fan requests. 
You know what the fans desire... don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! "Nature in an apron was so cute!" 
"I want to see her cute side again"... 
Saying whatever you please, aren't you 
guys...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Agh, whatever, come what may! An 
Umamusume is all about grit! 
Let's give 'em a Val-Fan-Meet as sweet as 
chocolate, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
